source_snapshot.deepseek_finding: DeepSeek correctly identifies a vendor package and topology dependency, but its executable example only displays and truncates help output through insecure SSH; it cannot exercise or prove the BlueField EOM test.

original_test_intent.purpose: Execute the owner-approved NVQual NT.2 BlueField end-of-manufacturing network test and verify that every test instantiated by the approved test manifest passes.
original_test_intent.target: The exact BlueField device, its mapped network ports/functions, required peer endpoints and host or embedded execution environment identified by the platform owner.
original_test_intent.scope: One complete approved NT.2 network suite for the specified BlueField topology within the source's 180-minute machine-time estimate; it is not an NVQual installation check, help query or generic single-port traffic test.
original_test_intent.operation: Establish the approved device/port/peer mapping and baseline, validate the supplied NVQual package and configuration, run the exact NT.2 suite from its designated execution location, retain every launched subtest and raw result, stop safely on infrastructure or device faults and verify return to baseline.
original_test_intent.duration_and_iterations: The source records 180 minutes of machine time but does not define active traffic duration, warm-up, subtest count or rerun policy. Preserve the 180-minute planning envelope and obtain those exact values from the approved NT.2 manifest rather than inventing or shortening them.
original_test_intent.expected_result: Every subtest required by the approved NT.2 manifest completes with the vendor-defined PASS result; no required case is skipped, aborted, missing or silently filtered, and the BlueField, host, peers and links remain or return healthy.
original_test_intent.required_evidence: Immutable package/version/configuration identity; BlueField mode, device and port/function mapping; peer/topology and execution-location record; approvals; full launch/configuration; complete per-subtest raw results and timestamps; relevant link/device/host health before, during and after; abort/recovery records; manifest completeness reconciliation.
ambiguities: The exact NVQual build, NT.2 command/configuration, subtest manifest and vendor PASS semantics are absent.
The BlueField model, operating mode and whether the suite runs on the host, embedded Arm environment or another controller are absent.
The physical/logical port, function, peer and traffic-isolation topology is absent.
The source gives 180 minutes of machine time but no active duration, repetitions or rerun rule.

v2_review_conclusion.finding: V2 correctly rejects the help-only shortcut and requires the package, topology, secure access, approval, complete results and recovery. It over-specifies throughput, latency and loss evidence that the source does not promise, omits the 180-minute planning fact, and does not make the execution location or required-manifest completeness explicit.

applicable_history.decision: The V2 entry preserves the NT.2 network-suite intent and REQUIRES classification. No later user ruling supplies an NVQual command, package, topology, duration or acceptance manifest for this source row.
Missing vendor packages, parameters and acceptance data are readiness dependencies, not proof that this understood vendor-suite operation is permanently non-automatable.

v3_review_conclusion.summary: Keep V2's classification and approval gate. Preserve the 180-minute source estimate, require the owner-defined execution location and complete NT.2 manifest, and judge completeness by that manifest without inventing a fixed metric list.

available_now: The source identifies the BlueField EOM network-test family, requires all tests to pass and records 30 minutes attended plus 180 minutes machine time.
Read-only device, mode, software, interface, link and package-presence inventory can be collected without generating test traffic.
missing_inputs: The NVIDIA/vendor or platform owner must provide the approved NVQual build, entitlement if applicable, integrity reference, exact NT.2 command/configuration, subtest manifest and vendor result semantics.
The network/platform owner must provide the BlueField model/mode, execution location, immutable device/port/function/peer topology, cabling, traffic isolation and any suite-defined thresholds.
The lab owner must provide the maintenance window, traffic authorization, console/recovery path and rerun/abort policy.
execution_readiness_detail.input_owner: The NVIDIA/vendor or platform owner supplies the tool and suite definition; the network owner supplies topology and isolation; the lab owner supplies authorization and recovery readiness.
safe_read_only_work_before_closure: Record BlueField PCIe identity, serial/model, firmware, operating mode, host and embedded software versions, network functions/interfaces, link state and current health/counters.
Check package presence/version/integrity and capture untruncated supported capability/help output without launching a test or altering links.
prohibited_until_closed: Do not guess the NVQual command, execution location, peers, ports, functions, duration, thresholds or rerun policy; generate traffic on shared or production links; change BlueField mode/firmware/network configuration; expose credentials; disable host verification; truncate results; or treat help output as a test PASS.
execution_readiness_detail.closure_verification: Reconcile the signed suite configuration and topology with the exact device, prove secure access/storage/monitoring and recovery, obtain traffic approval, then account for every required subtest and confirm post-test device/peer/link health.

revision_candidate.test_name: BlueField NVQual NT.2 End-of-Manufacturing Network Test
revision_candidate.purpose: Run the owner-approved NVQual NT.2 BlueField network suite and verify that every required suite case passes without leaving the device or test topology unhealthy.
revision_candidate.applicable_platform_environment: The exact owner-identified BlueField model and operating mode, compatible host/embedded software and firmware, NVQual build and isolated peer topology specified by the NT.2 qualification recipe.
revision_candidate.target_scope: The immutable BlueField device, mapped ports/functions, host or embedded execution environment and all peer endpoints in the approved NT.2 manifest. Plan for the source's 180-minute machine-time estimate; use only the manifest-defined active durations and iterations.
revision_candidate.required_inputs: Approved NVQual package/build and integrity or entitlement data; exact NT.2 command/configuration and required-case manifest; vendor PASS semantics; BlueField model/mode and execution location; device/port/function/peer mapping; cabling and isolation; compatible stack; storage/time sync; approval; stop, rerun and recovery rules.
revision_candidate.test_command_procedure_intent: Securely inventory and baseline the mapped device, links and peers; validate the supplied package and configuration without changing state; launch the exact owner-approved NT.2 suite from its designated execution environment; retain unfiltered output and health evidence for every required subtest; stop according to policy; terminate traffic and verify restoration to baseline.
revision_candidate.preconditions: Correct BlueField and peers identified; signed manifest/configuration available; package and stack compatible; approved cabling, link state and isolated traffic path established; clocks/storage/monitoring ready; no conflicting workload; secure authenticated access, console and recovery available; maintenance approval recorded.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: Device/model/serial/PCIe and BlueField-mode identity; host/embedded firmware, driver, DOCA and NVQual identities; signed manifest/configuration and topology map; approvals; baselines; exact launch; full per-required-subtest timestamps, status and raw output; suite-defined measurements; link/device/host/peer health; abort/recovery and final-state records; completeness table showing no unapproved skip or omission.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: The owner-approved NVQual NT.2 manifest and vendor result rules for the exact BlueField platform, constrained by source criteria `All tests pass`. A help or capability check is never acceptance evidence.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: Use only the approved isolated topology and secure access. Do not invent commands or thresholds, change mode/firmware/network state outside the recipe, load an unapproved peer/link, expose secrets, bypass host verification, discard or truncate failures, continue after a stop condition, or declare PASS from partial execution.
revision_candidate.human_approval_requirements: A platform/network/lab owner must approve the exact suite, topology, traffic window, isolation, configuration-changing steps if any, stop/rerun policy and recovery path. Read-only preparation does not authorize test traffic.
revision_candidate.manual_boundaries: Automation may inventory, launch the supplied suite, collect evidence and evaluate explicit vendor statuses. Engineers provide/install the controlled package, establish physical topology and isolation, authorize load and judge anomalies not covered by the supplied rules.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: On an approved stop, halt suite traffic without broad unrelated process termination, preserve partial output and counters, restore only recipe-authorized network state, verify BlueField/host/peer/link health and require owner disposition before rerun.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: Package/configuration/topology/execution-location mismatch; missing required case or peer/link; insecure access; loss of output, time sync or monitoring; unexpected external traffic or congestion; link/device/host/peer fault; suite/tool crash; thermal/power or platform-health alarm; unapproved state change; or failure to restore baseline.

identified_defects: DeepSeek's `nvqual -h | head` command neither executes NT.2 nor preserves complete evidence and uses insecure authentication/host-key handling.
The source omits the proprietary suite definition, execution location and topology, so a runnable command or fixed measurement list cannot be inferred.
V2 invents throughput/latency/loss as universally required fields and does not preserve the source's 180-minute machine-time estimate.
Neither source nor V2 explicitly prevents an unapproved skipped/aborted subtest from being hidden by an aggregate result.
reason_for_change: Make the agent execute and reconcile the actual owner-supplied NT.2 suite on the correct BlueField context, while preserving source timing and avoiding unsupported assumptions about vendor metrics or execution location.

new_technical_evidence.title: NVIDIA BlueField DPU Modes of Operation
new_technical_evidence.applicability: BlueField devices only; the target model and deployed mode remain unknown
new_technical_evidence.supports: BlueField DPU and NIC operating modes assign network-resource ownership differently, so the test execution location and accessible functions cannot be assumed from the word BlueField alone.
new_technical_evidence.remaining_uncertainty: The source does not identify the BlueField SKU, mode, NVQual release or whether NT.2 is launched from the host, embedded Arm environment or another controller.

removed_ambiguities: Separates the 180-minute planning estimate from unknown suite-defined active durations and iterations.
Requires a signed required-case manifest and per-case reconciliation before `All tests pass` can be claimed.
Makes BlueField operating mode, execution location and exact device/port/function/peer mapping explicit inputs.
Uses suite-defined measurements instead of presenting V2's inferred throughput/latency/loss list as source requirements.
resolved_blockers: Missing proprietary inputs do not prevent safe read-only inventory and do not convert an understood vendor-suite workflow into permanent BLOCKED.
remaining_blockers: The suite cannot run until the exact controlled package, NT.2 manifest/configuration, result rules, execution location, topology/isolation, authorization and recovery plan are supplied.
objective_improvement_over_v2: V3 preserves V2's safe package-and-approval gate but makes scope completeness auditable, retains the 180-minute source estimate and removes unsupported universal metrics, reducing both false PASS and test-intent drift.

agent_understanding_result.notes: The validator recovered the exact BlueField/device/port/function/peer scope, host-versus-embedded execution-location gate, manifest-defined durations and iterations, 180-minute planning-only meaning, complete per-subtest evidence, authorization and recovery. It rejected help output, partial suites, aggregate PASS, guessed port/location values and unapproved traffic. Missing proprietary artifacts and mappings are PLATFORM_HANDOFF_DEFECT; inventing or bypassing them would be MODEL_PLANNING_ERROR.

per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_purpose_fact: Functionality row 2123 is a BlueField EOM NT.2 network suite with `All tests pass`, 30 attended minutes and 180 machine minutes.
per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_v2_comparison: V2 rejects help-only evidence but omits the 180-minute source estimate and assumes fixed metric categories not guaranteed by the absent NT.2 manifest.
per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_safety_evidence_decision: Allow secure read-only inventory before closure; permit traffic only with the exact package, manifest, execution context, topology, isolation, approval and recovery.
